description: W.W. Grainger, Inc., incorporated in the State of Illinois in 1928, is a broad line distributor of maintenance, repair and operating (MRO) products and services with operations primarily in North America, Japan and the United Kingdom, and in the fourth quarter of 2025 it exited the U.K. market by completing the sale of the Cromwell business and closing the Zoro U.K. business. Grainger's strategic framework, the Grainger Edge, uniquely defines the company by asserting why it exists, how it serves customers and how team members work together to achieve its objectives, and Grainger's purpose is We Keep The World Working, and in its High-Touch Solutions N.A. segment customers are typically mid-size and large businesses with complex purchasing operations and processes that expect product and service depth and are focused on total cost of procurement, and such customers utilize sophisticated electronic purchasing platforms that communicate directly with Grainger's systems through eProcurement technology, with sales and service representatives driving customer relationships by helping select the right products and reducing costs.
